name: Ren Su
life: “I still remember washing a white shirt with a button sewn under the label.” On Monday, near Paper & Pine Books, Ren starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: I can't give money. I can wash twenty shirts while the school uniform fund catches up.
appearance: Ren has a long face and high cheekbones. Look for short black hair swept back. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a sand-colored linen shirt with a braided bracelet with a single wooden bead. In conversation Ren leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Ren tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Ren will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To supply clean shirts through the first term.
family: Shay Gray is Ren’s cousin raised in the same household. Ren makes the call. Shay is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The missing name on the stern*, Shay says, “I changed the family name when I arrived here.”
connections: Karim Klein. A former musician who slept at school understands the price of a clean practice shirt.

reactions.situation: A relative urges the pupil to accept in public
reactions.response: Ren lets the pupil answer privately before relatives announce an acceptance.

reactions.situation: An envelope of wages is found under a café chair
reactions.response: Ren finds a second person to witness its return so an honest mistake won't cost a worker their pay.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Ren repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
